name: Systems thinking competency
definition: the abilities to recognize and understand relationships; to analyse complex systems; to think of how systems are embedded within different domains and different scales; and to deal with uncertainty.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Anticipatory competency
definition: the abilities to understand and evaluate multiple futures – possible, probable and desirable; to create one’s own visions for the future; to apply the precautionary principle; to assess the consequences of actions; and to deal with risks and changes.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Normative competency
definition: the abilities to understand and reflect on the norms and values that underlie one’s actions; and to negotiate sustainability values, principles, goals, and targets, in a context of conflicts of interests and trade-offs, uncertain knowledge and contradictions.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Strategic competency
definition: the abilities to collectively develop and implement innovative actions that further sustainability at the local level and further afield.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Collaboration competency
definition: the abilities to learn from others; to understand and respect the needs, perspectives and actions of others (empathy); to understand, relate to and be sensitive to others (empathic leadership); to deal with conflicts in a group; and to facilitate collaborative and participatory problem solving.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Critical thinking competency
definition: the ability to question norms, practices and opinions; to reflect on own one’s values, perceptions and actions; and to take a position in the sustainability discourse.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Self-awareness competency
definition: the ability to reflect on one’s own role in the local community and (global) society; to continually evaluate and further motivate one’s actions; and to deal with one’s feelings and desires.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency

name: Integrated problem-solving competency
definition: the overarching ability to apply different problem-solving frameworks to complex sustainability problems and develop viable, inclusive and equitable solution options that promote sustainable development, integrating the above-mentioned competences.
:LABEL: ESDCompetency
